stack: Arbitrum Orbit (Nitro), ETH gas, Ethereum blob DA
rules: Every entry starts as VERIFY. It moves to VERIFIED only with a non-null checksummed address, a verifiedAt date, a verifiedBy handle, and findings recorded.
M0 does not close, and M1 does not close, while any entry the vault layer depends on is still VERIFY.
scripts/check_addresses.py enforces the schema in CI.

uniswapV4._note: Addresses from docs.bags.fm/robinhood/overview, cross-checked on-chain 2026-09-07: PositionManager, StateView and V4Quoter all return PoolManager 0x8366a39CC670B4001A1121B8F6A443A643e40951 from poolManager(); PositionManager.permit2() is the canonical Permit2. FINDING: the UniversalRouter is a modified fork. Its v4 swap struct carries an extra minHopPriceX36 field, so stock Uniswap SDK calldata reverts. EntryRouter's front-end encoding and every M6 router must target this ABI. Still open: periphery version, subscriber behaviour on transfer, hook permission bit layout. Uniswap's own docs list only v3 for this chain.

kyberswap._note: KyberSwap's two routers on Robinhood Chain mainnet, both admitted as executors of LoopRouter.loopVia and GageV2CashoutRouter.cashOutVia by mainnet's release profile (contracts.leverage.executors, contracts.cashout.executors; D243, D245, D246): the valuation service asks KyberSwap for a Router V3 route first and for MetaAggregationRouterV2's when that request fails or the calling router does not admit V3 (docs/api.md, KyberSwap's routers). Third-party contracts: not gage's, outside the bug bounty's scope. Read on 2026-10-13 over a read-only mainnet relay and the public node; mainnet-fork runs of 2026-10-13 (contracts/test/loop/LoopRouterKyber.fork.t.sol, contracts/test/v2/GageV2CashoutKyber.fork.t.sol, contracts/test/loop/KyberRouterV3.fork.t.sol) sold and bought NVDA through both.

RouterV3.why: KSAggregationRouterV3, asked first (D246). Before VERIFIED: a founder review of its admin's powers (defaultAdmin grants EXECUTOR_ROLE, unpauses and rescues, with no delay; guardians pause) and of the code its audit does not cover.
RouterV3.findings: 16,858 bytes of runtime, keccak 0x0495909c9f14bcdb7976b38e8f69c1b17e7a437fdc468fcc59f79ee46baf8b97, the Sourcify exact match of KyberNetwork/ks-aggregation-router on Ethereum; no EIP-1967 implementation slot (no proxy). Named by KyberSwap's /routes only with useRouterV3=true, a parameter its published API specification does not list. defaultAdmin() 0xeB28e1C4c47b471a88B00bA93163a3a44AE65D9C (KyberSwap's operator multisig); PERMIT2() canonical; KyberSwap's executor 0x8F10B468b06c6FD214B65F87778827F7D113f996 holds EXECUTOR_ROLE; paused() false. A built call pulls its input with the router's own transferFrom from the caller (exact approval of the router). totalSupply() and decimals() revert. Hexens audit, 24 Nov to 5 Dec 2025; ksExecute(bytes) and the public swap added in January 2026 are not covered.

MetaAggregationRouterV2.why: D239's router, the fallback since D246. Before VERIFIED: a founder review of its owner's powers (D245's open question 1: executor whitelist, rescueFunds, pause).
MetaAggregationRouterV2.findings: 13,724 bytes of runtime, keccak 0xdc6eb20a6d4701d8f0f04f9a3342d254eb2698bbad281d8578d6efba21865867; no EIP-1967 implementation slot (no proxy). Named by KyberSwap's /routes without useRouterV3. owner() 0x1874028262F1F4B2DD1F2700A72Ee8b9b7C69090; WETH() is mainnet WETH 0x0Bd7D308f8E1639FAb988df18A8011f41EAcAD73; paused(), totalSupply() and decimals() revert. A built call pulls its input with transferFrom from the caller (exact approval of the router).

arbitrumProtocol._note: Nitro rollup contracts from docs.robinhood.com/chain/protocol-contracts, read 2026-09-07. VERIFY each on the explorer before use. The Delayed Inbox is the force-inclusion path for a borrower's reclaim during a sequencer outage (engineering brief 11) and the programmatic ETH deposit path (Inbox.depositEth).

DelayedInbox.why: Read maxTimeVariation / delay parameters here to resolve chain.forceInclusionDelay.
depositEth() here moves Sepolia ETH to the same address on chain 46630.

memeTokens._note: Meme lane (spec 7.4). Each candidate needs the screening service's listing note before it is allowlisted: stock-paired v4 pool on the chain, pool age >= 7 days, market cap >= 1,000,000 USDG as a 7-day median, contract checks (mint after launch, pause, transfer tax, blocklist, proxy). Caps 1% per deal and 5% per asset of pool depth, raw units, revisited weekly. GAGE excluded for the first three months; sGAGE never.
_perTokenChecks: stock pool id and pair Stock Token

_firstCandidate.why: Needed for the M1 exit test (real meme on the fork). Pick the deepest stock-paired meme on the chain that passes 7.4.
